action.prompt: A new asset was added under public/assets. Check docs/CREDITS.md for an entry naming this file, its author, source URL and license. If missing, add a row with what is known and mark unknown fields as TODO, then remind me to fill them in. Warn loudly if the license is not CC0, CC-BY or the project's own work. Also warn if a .glb is over 3 MB or a texture over 2048px, and suggest compressing it.
